source.title: Billing model source
source.description: Controls billing and model display globally. Requests without a configured price are allowed, but user charges are not recorded. Only administrators can inspect internal mappings. Historical charges are not recalculated.

price.title: Requested model price
price.description: Used for requested-model billing, independently of channel prices. Unpriced requests are allowed without recording user charges. Changes apply to subsequent requests only.
price.free: No billing items: this model will be free.
